description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


## 中文

- 可以自定义截图和贴图的鼠标操作。裁剪贴图时可以取消，贴图不透明度最低可调到 10%。
- 拼图新增自由布局，可以拖动图片调整位置。编辑时，对齐参考线在高分屏上显示得更清晰。
- 新增复制识别文字的快捷键。缩放或更改应用字体后，识别和翻译文字会继续贴合原来的区域。
- Snow Shot 完整版登录后可在设备间同步设置。截图历史可以保留全部记录、仅保留截图结果，或关闭记录。
- 新增俄语界面。快捷截取焦点窗口更快，并修复了菜单重复弹出的问题。

## English

- Customize mouse gestures for screenshots and pinned images. You can cancel a pin crop and lower pin opacity to 10%.
- Arrange collage images freely by dragging them. Alignment guides look sharper on high-DPI screens.
- Use the new shortcut to copy recognized text. Recognized and translated text stays aligned when you zoom or change the app font.
- Sign in to sync settings across devices in the full edition. Screenshot History can keep everything, keep only the finished screenshots, or stop saving history.
- Russian is now available as an interface language. Direct capture of the focused window is faster, and duplicate pop-up menus have been fixed.
